## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the Developer Certificate of Origin in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] `check` passes (JUnit and GameTests).
- [ ] Changes to world edits, undo and redo, saved formats, the network protocol or permissions have failure-case tests.
- [ ] Docs and the wiki are updated where players or server admins see a difference.
